item.title: Kramer, Vail combine for 50 points as Tigers hold off Phoenix, 85-79
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The Campbellsville University men's basketball team hosted the Cumberland University Phoenix on Saturday afternoon at the Powell Athletic Center. Behind a combined 50 points from Dalton Kramer and Marcellus Vail, the Tigers secured a hard-fought victory, 85-79.

item.title: Campbell hits 'A' Standard in New York; Tigers shine in split-squad action
item.description: NEW YORK, N.Y. / LOUISVILLE, Ky. — The Campbellsville University Track & Field teams proved they can compete on any stage this weekend, testing themselves against top-tier competition at the Rutgers Scarlet Knights Open in New York City while continuing their strong indoor campaign at the Eastern Indoors Collegiate in Louisville.

item.title: Olivia Messerly claims title, Tigers nab 3 podium finishes at Blue Raider Open
item.description: COLUMBIA, Ky. – The #15 Campbellsville University women's wrestling team traveled to Columbia on Saturday for the Blue Raider Open, leaving with hardware as three Tigers earned podium finishes. Leading the charge was #16 Olivia Messerly, who captured the 131-pound championship, while #15 Addison Messerly and #12 Kylee Tait battled through the consolation brackets to take third place in their respective weight classes.

item.title: Tigers bounce back to upset #11 William Carey after extra-inning heartbreaker
item.description: HATTIESBURG, Miss. – On a day defined by dramatic swings of momentum, the Campbellsville University baseball team endured an 11-inning, 4-3 heartbreaking loss to Columbia International University before roaring back to upset #11 William Carey University 7-4 in the nightcap.

item.title: Tigers extend best start since 2020 with pair of wins
item.description: OWENSBORO, Ky. — The #9 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team capped off a perfect weekend on Saturday, taking down Judson University and Calumet College of St. Joseph to improve to 10-0 on the season.

item.title: Crewe-Brown claims breaststroke title; Tigers set school records at MSC Championships
item.description: DANVILLE, Ky. – With the stakes at their highest and one final chance to punch tickets before nationals, the Campbellsville University swim teams rose to the moment at the Mid-South Conference Championships. The Tigers delivered record-breaking swims, provisional qualifiers, and championship-final performances throughout the weekend at the Boles Natatorium.
